int64_t read_int() {
    char c = getchar();
    int64_t x = 0, sign = 1;
    while (c < '0' || c > '9') { if (c == '-') sign = -sign; c = getchar(); }
    while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') { x = x * 10 + c - '0'; c = getchar(); }
    return x * sign;
}

int64_t mod_pow(int64_t base, int64_t exp, int64_t mod) {
    int64_t res = 1;
    while (exp) {
        if (exp & 1) res = res * base % mod;
        base = base * base % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    int64_t n = read_int(), m = read_int(), P = read_int();
    int maxn = n + 1;
    vector<int64_t> fac(maxn + 1, 1), inv(maxn + 1, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= maxn; ++i) fac[i] = fac[i-1] * i % P;
    inv[maxn] = mod_pow(fac[maxn], P-2, P);
    for (int i = maxn; i >= 1; --i) inv[i-1] = inv[i] * i % P;

    auto C = [&](int x, int y) -> int64_t {
        if (x < y || y < 0) return 0;
        return fac[x] * inv[y] % P * inv[x-y] % P;
    };
    auto S = [](int x) -> int64_t { return x * (x + 1) / 2; };

    vector<int64_t> f(m + 1, 0), g(m + 1, 0);
    f[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {

            int64_t comb = C(i-1, j);
            int64_t fj = f[j], fij = f[i-1-j];
            int64_t gj = g[j], gij = g[i-1-j];
            f[i] = (f[i] + fj * fij % P * comb) % P;
            g[i] = (g[i] + ((gj * fij + fj * gij) % P * (i+1) % P + fj * fij % P * (S(j) + S(i-1-j)) % P) * comb) % P;
        }
        f[i] = f[i] * (i+1) % P;
    }

    vector<vector<int64_t>> F(m + 1, vector<int64_t>(n + 1, 0));
    vector<vector<int64_t>> G(m + 1, vector<int64_t>(n + 1, 0));
    for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) F[0][j] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        F[i][i] = f[i]; G[i][i] = g[i];
        for (int j = i + 1; j <= n; ++j) {
            F[i][j] = F[i][j-1];
            G[i][j] = G[i][j-1];
            for (int l = 1; l <= i; ++l) {

                G[i][j] = (G[i][j] + (Gil * fl + Fil * gl) % P * comb) % P;
